The scene will be designed so that each item serves as a landmark/waypoint that guides the agent toward the next item. The acacia_sign will contain directional instructions pointing toward the light_blue_concrete_powder and cyan_concrete_powder locations. The redstone_lamp will serve as a lit beacon indicating the area where the sign is located. This creates a logical exploration chain: find the lit redstone_lamp beacon → read the acacia_sign near it → follow directions to find light_blue_concrete_powder → continue to find cyan_concrete_powder nearby. This forms a coherent navigation puzzle without requiring deep Minecraft crafting knowledge.

design_notes: Player spawns at origin facing +Z. Beacon (redstone lamps on redstone block) at ~3,0-2,3. Sign at ~5,0,3 facing south (toward spawn). Light_blue_concrete_powder at ~5,0,8 (5 blocks north of sign). Cyan_concrete_powder at ~5,0,12 (4 blocks further north). Fences and torch add visual interest and help mark the beacon area. The sequential +Z placement ensures the agent must pass the light_blue powder before reaching the cyan powder.
